info.name: ST-242 - API Tests
info.description:
API - ST-242 - Salesforce Mastered Contact (External) Integration

══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
Purpose: Validate Salesforce Mastered External Contact API operations (create/update)
are published one-way into Dynamics Dataverse in near-real time via MuleSoft
Flow: API Create/Update Contact → Platform Event → MuleSoft → Dynamics
Dependency: Parent Account must have Dataverse_ID__c populated
Reference: Excel "I contacts -> externalcontact" tab
Integration Document: Contact & Account section
═══════════════════════

Generated from: C:\Automation\E2EAutomation\src\features\api\ST\ST-242.feature

## Setup Instructions:
1. Import this collection into Postman
2. Create a new environment (or use existing Salesforce QA environment)
3. Set the following environment variables:
   - `sf_base_url`: https://arx--qa.sandbox.my.salesforce.com
   - `sf_api_version`: v60.0
   - `sf_access_token`: Your Salesforce access token (get via OAuth or JWT)
   - `sf_instance_url`: Your Salesforce instance URL

## Authentication:
This collection uses Bearer Token authentication. Obtain an access token via:
- OAuth 2.0 flow
- JWT Bearer Token flow
- Username/Password flow
